dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: A few days ago, I actually came up with the perfect crime while I was drinking under the windmill, looking for inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I was too drunk. I only managed to scrawl out a few words on a scrap of paper... By the time I sobered up, it was gone.

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: All I remember now is the chirping of birds above my head... Was it a dream? Or was it real...
